blocks.text: Anne Curtis spoke out against a netizen who claimed she underwent facial surgical enhancements and even made comments about the physical features of the actress-TV host’s daughter, Dahlia. The “It’s Showtime” mainstay responded to an X user who shared a zoomed-in photo of her taken at the recent Preview Ball and wrote, “Retokada yarn? Exhibit A – anak.” Curtis—who shares one daughter with her husband, Erwan Heussaff—dismissed the claim and replied, “Can proudly say I’m not retokada at all and for me, for me lang naman, my daughter and I are both beautiful.” Despite the negative remark, Curtis opted to show […]...
